definitions.explanation: The visible mist rising from hot water or food. Specifically refers to water vapor that can be seen.

examples.japanese: ⟦お→お〜：03097_o⟧⟦{風呂|ふろ}→風呂：14633_furo⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{湯気|ゆげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}っている→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: Steam is rising from the bath.

examples.japanese: ⟦{熱|あつ}い→熱い：09888_atsui⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{湯気|ゆげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}ている→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Steam is coming from the hot food.

examples.japanese: {湯気|ゆげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{眼鏡|めがね}→眼鏡：00651_megane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{曇|くも}った→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧。
examples.english: My glasses fogged up from the steam.

examples.english: When I opened the window on a cold morning, the steam from the kitchen flowed outside and looked like a white cloud.

notes:
{湯気|ゆげ} specifically refers to the visible mist that rises from hot water or food — the white vapor you can see. It is an everyday word commonly associated with baths, cooking, and hot drinks.

FORMS:
⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water) + ⟦{気|げ}→気：02199_ki⟧ (vapor, spirit).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯気|ゆげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: steam rises
- {湯気|ゆげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: steam comes out
- {湯気|ゆげ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|のぼ}る→立ち上る：10670_tachinoboru⟧: steam rises up
- {湯気|ゆげ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{曇|くも}る→曇る：00723_kumoru⟧: to fog up from steam (glasses, mirrors)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {湯気|ゆげ}: visible steam from hot water/food (everyday)
- ⟦{蒸気|じょうき}→蒸気：04278_jouki⟧: steam (technical; also steam engines, steam power)
- ⟦{水蒸気|すいじょうき}→水蒸気：13263_suijouki⟧: water vapor (scientific term)
- ⟦{煙|けむり}→煙：02705_kemuri⟧: smoke (from fire/burning — different substance)
